XI. COMPENDIUM OF PUBLIC HEARING TESTIMONY, JULY 11, 1974
As a part of the Environmental Impact Statement process the public has been afforded an opportunity to present their views as to the social, economic, environmental, and other effects of the proposed Airport Spur facility.
The following individuals presented oral testimony at an Environmental Public Hearing, July 11, 1974 for the proposed freeway and their views have been made a part of the official transcript. Abstracts of their testimony and responses follow:
